About_&_Key_Points:
About
Atal Realtech Ltd is a Nashik-based
civil contractor executing public buildings, hospitals, educational facilities, housing,
water infrastructure, roads, bridges and
irrigation projects, primarily for Maharashtra government departments, PSUs and development authorities. It undertakes
projects directly and through subcontracting, while wholly owned Atal Realty Ltd marks its entry into real estate and land development.
[1]
[2]
Key Points
Business & execution:
[1]
The company executes civil works
under item-rate, turnkey and design
-build contracts, directly or as a sub
contractor. It holds Class I-A unlimited
-capacity registration with Maharashtra’s
Tribal Development/PW (Tribal) division
and Class IV PWD registration. Capabilities
cover design review, procurement, construction and finishing; equipment fleet size/utilisation is not disclosed.
